critical_code_review_comments: photoStaging.js auto-attach listeners at module import time (lines 210-213) register on EVERY import. Because the module is a singleton in webpack this is fine, but worth noting that flushStaged is also called from StagedPhotoBadge useEffect on mount — three triggers (mount + online + focus) on the same flushing path. The _flushing guard handles re-entrancy correctly.
offlineQueue.js registerAutoReplay is fine but _allKnownFormKeys is module-scoped — multi-tab scenarios will not cross-register. Acceptable per doctrine (foreground only).

AdminDlsDay1Debrief useEffect that resets state on variant change (line 137-152) re-fetches questions and resets answers/notes/doctrine to empty when route swaps. This intentionally bypasses the per-variant draft until the useFormDraft auto-prompt path fires — verified working in live test (Week-1 didn't pick up Day-1's draft).
